title: Where Plants and Animals Live
seo_title: Kindergarten Habitat Worksheets: Where Plants and Animals Live and Why
standard_text: Use a model to represent the relationship between the needs of different plants and animals (including humans) and the places they live.
meta_desc: Free kindergarten science worksheets on where plants and animals live (NGSS K-ESS3-1): ponds, forests, meadows and deserts, and why each living thing lives there. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Living things live where needs are met.
key_sub: Fish live in water. Squirrels live in trees.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living things live where their needs are met.

  • Fish: water. Squirrels: trees.
  • Bees: flowers. Cactus: desert.
  • People live near food and water.
Example

Where should a fish go in the model?

Fish need water.

Answer: the pond

Example

Why does a squirrel live in a forest?

Trees give food and a home.

Answer: nuts and trees

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a fish can live in a tree.
  • Thinking animals can live anywhere.
  • Thinking plants grow well where it is dark.

faq.q: Why do animals live in different places?
faq.a: Each place gives them what they need: food, water and shelter.
Where they get the light and water they need. A cactus needs little water, so it grows in the desert.

faq.q: How can kids make a model?
faq.a: Draw or build a pond, a forest and a meadow, then place each animal where it can meet its needs.
